decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program has its own page and fills an unmet need for working patients; demand is still uncertain, but the insurer-financed service is cheap to keep within existing clinic infrastructure, so the option stays open.
The custom furniture carpentry builds on existing workshop production know-how and staff, so carrying it costs little while its market value is still unfolding.

Outpatient sociotherapy is only mentioned on the website and its uptake is uncertain, but it is a low-cost add-on to existing psychiatric teams, which favors keeping the option rather than abandoning it early.
The senior living counseling service is featured on the home page, signaling strategic commitment, and it supports referrals into the firm's core eldercare business at minimal cost.
The retail shop is only mentioned and has some fixed costs, but it gives the sheltered workshop a sales outlet and inclusion value, and one year of results is too little to justify abandoning it.
